items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: One of them being Minor, I think it was Minor, with whom she played.

ctx.x: I've never heard of her, you know her, didn't she?

No. She wasn't too well known because she was a school teacher, but she was a very good pianist. She was a young man, and she did play with musicians sometimes. One of them being Minor, I think it was Minor, with whom she played. But she was very good. And she and I started taking music lessons at the same time. We were the most brilliant students I would teach at. So I know she was very good. But of course she was teaching school, and music was secondary with her.
I mean, were there any records that you were influenced by? I mean, did you hear any jazz records around that time that influenced you at all?
